resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register calls it an R-6 flat top tower; firelookout.com lists a 1960 cupola trailer and a 1963 two-story R-6 cab. The brief's two_story kind follows firelookout.com. The story reports both.
Register gives 7,639 ft (2,328 m); firelookout.com gives 7658 ft. The record keeps the register figure of 2328.4 m.

notes_for_editor: The register and firelookout.com disagree on the tower's form (flat top versus two-story cab). Neither gives a removal date; the Montana page's bare 'Removed' label is ambiguous, so the story gives no date for removal. Firelookout.com's photo credit names Larry Smith, while the register spells the name Lawrence. Forest Fire Lookout Association Facebook posts give different 1960 and 1961 wording, but their text was not readable from the cache, so they are not used. The brief's access 'unknown' was left unset.
